name: InternTrack API
postCreateCommand: sudo rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/yarn.list && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y postgresql redis-server && sudo su - -c "service postgresql start && su - postgres -c 'psql -c \"ALTER USER postgres PASSWORD '\''postgres'\'';\"' && su - postgres -c 'createdb interntrack'" && chmod +x mvnw
postStartCommand: sudo su - -c "service postgresql start && service redis-server start"
